query: I spent my weekend hiking up the local forest trail, and I found the most beautiful patch of wild blueberries growing right off the side of the path, I picked a whole container full and made blueberry pancakes for breakfast this morning that turned out so fluffy and sweet, my cat even tried to steal a bite off my plate when I wasn’t looking. I also finished that mystery novel I’ve been reading for weeks last night, the ending was totally unexpected I never would have guessed the librarian was the culprit. Anyway, I’m having an issue with my phone right now: airplane mode is turned on, my SIM card is locked with a PIN, and my line is suspended because of an overdue bill, can you help me figure out what I need to do to get it working again?
